title: Mage Power Sequence
description: Four sequential poses of a female mage with teal hair and purple outfit demonstrating magical abilities against a gray background. From left to right: casting a circular energy shield, raising arms to summon a swirling turquoise tornado, projecting a bright explosive energy blast from both hands, and standing in a ready stance with residual magic wisps.
prompt: A female mage with short teal hair and facial markings, wearing a purple cropped top with black cape, teal pants with star patterns and black boots, shown in four sequential action poses. First pose creating a circular teal energy shield, second summoning a swirling turquoise tornado above her raised hands, third unleashing a bright white and cyan explosive energy blast from both palms, fourth in a combat stance with magic wisps. Clean digital illustration style on solid gray background.
